additional_findings.reason: F2 cites lem-homogeneous-poisson-ordered-event-time-density for simplicity of an arbitrary supplied Poisson process, but that lemma proves simplicity only for the process it constructs. Verification 1.1 transfers that conclusion without an argument identifying the supplied configuration law or directly excluding collisions. The conclusion is true; this is an unsupported citation transfer, not a counterexample to simplicity.
additional_findings.recommended_repair: Restrict F2 to the constructed process and prove simplicity of the supplied process from its disjoint Poisson counts: for the 2^k dyadic cells of (0,1], the probability any cell contains at least two points is at most 2^k E[N_cell(N_cell-1)]/2 = 2^(-k-1), so a repeated occurrence has probability zero. The scalar factorial moment is already available from the declared Poisson moment lemma. No new item or Statement change is necessary.
